entities.name: SLC6A4
observations: Encodes the serotonin transporter; its intron-2 STin2 VNTR was tested for tobacco-use and mood-disorder comorbidity.

entities.name: SLC6A4 STin2 VNTR
observations: In a study of 113 never-smokers, 62 mood-disorder-only patients, 90 tobacco-use-disorder-only patients, and 95 comorbid patients, STin2.12 was positively associated with comorbidity (OR 3.07, 95% CI 1.41–6.68), while STin2.10/10 was negatively associated (OR 0.34, 95% CI 0.16–0.74).
Adjustment for education, age, sex, marital status, and ethnicity did not change the reported associations.

A separate case-control study found STin2.12 associated with tobacco-use disorder (OR 2.45, 95% CI 1.44–4.15; p<0.001) and STin2.10/10 protective (OR 0.42, 95% CI 0.25–0.71; p<0.001), but not smoking cessation or smoking characteristics.

entities.name: PMID:25451436
observations: Primary study titled STin2 VNTR polymorphism is associated with comorbid tobacco use and mood disorders.
Included depression or bipolar disorder and tobacco use disorder in mutually exclusive diagnostic groups.

entities.name: PMID:24968820
observations: Case-control study titled SLC6A4 STin2 VNTR genetic polymorphism is associated with tobacco use disorder, but not with successful smoking cessation or smoking characteristics.
Studied 185 current tobacco-use-disorder patients and 175 never-smokers.

entities.name: Tobacco-mood comorbidity
observations: Defined in the primary study as co-occurring tobacco use disorder and mood disorder, including depression or bipolar disorder.
